motivation: v0.76 showed source-to-Fourier power closure at common native nodes to near machine precision, while a fractional/log tangent-affinity gate was degraded by nodes near deep matter-transfer minima. v0.77 tests the additive eta=0 state tangent directly, without division by local d_m or P_m.

primary_native_window.selection_rule: all common native CLASS transfer nodes inside the closed k-z window

fixed_context_grid.role: context only; not used to select or remove native nodes

primary_state_observable.field: CLASS native total-matter transfer source d_m
primary_state_observable.lambda_affinity_metric: epsilon_lambda = ||T_lambda-mean_lambda(T_lambda)||_2 / ||mean_lambda(T_lambda)||_2 over all native nodes in the primary window
primary_state_observable.even_residual_metric: e_lambda = ||d_m(+lambda)+d_m(-lambda)-2 d_m(0)||_2 / [2 |lambda| ||mean_lambda(T_lambda)||_2] over the same native nodes

classification_rule.pass: all primary numerical gates pass -> V077_NATIVE_STATE_TANGENT_AFFINITY_PASS

interpretation_rule.if_pass: supports that the native eta=0 perturbation-state tangent is numerically affine without local fractional normalization; together with v0.76 native power closure, the v0.76 fractional-affinity excursion is consistent with conditioning near transfer minima rather than a failure of the additive state tangent
interpretation_rule.if_fail: native state-tangent non-affinity survives global L2 normalization and requires further numerical/implementation diagnosis
forbidden_claims: do not retroactively change v0.72-v0.76 classifications
do not claim nonlinear evolution was simulated
do not retune physical parameters or gates after seeing the result
